verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh rey yet' winhaj Amán chi' t'a jun niwan wa'el chi'.
Haxo yik wan yuk'an wino heb' winh, ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a ix Ester chi' icha tik: --k'an tas tza nib'ej t'ayin, ol wak' t'ayach, wach'chom a nanhalok in makb'en tik tza k'ana', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix Ester chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tato wach' in t'a yol a sat, tato scha a k'o'ol tas tzin k'an t'ayach, anhej wal tas tzin k'an t'ayach to max in a cha miljokchamok, max champaxlaj heb' wetchonhab'.

Yujto a in tik yet' heb' wetchonhab' chi', ix onh chonhchaji yik tzonh satjiel t'a junelnhej. Komonok wal tonhej onh chonhchajb'at chekab'ok, tato icha chi' tekan manh smojok to swik'ek' a tiempo, okxo jun, to ol onh satjokel t'a junelnhej, xchi ix.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj rey Asuero chi' icha tik: --¿Mach jun chi'? ¿B'ajtil ay jun mach sna'an jun tzal chi'? xchi winh.

Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ha winh ajk'ol chuk spensar chi', haton winhaj Amán tik, xchi ix. Ha wal yik ix yab'an jun lolonel winhaj Amán chi', sakxonhej ix aj yilji sat winh yuj xiwelal t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh ix reina Ester chi'.

Ix k'e wan winh rey chi', ix te kot yowal winh, ix elta winh t'a yol pat b'aj wan swa heb' chi'. Ix el winh b'aj ay yamak'il spalacio. Palta haxo winhaj Amán chi', ix yilan winh to wan yak'jioch chamel t'a yib'anh winh, ix kannhej winh b'aj ix wa heb' chi', ix tewioch winh t'a ix reina Ester chi' to tz'ak'ji niwank'olal winh yuj ix.

Ayik ix ochxik'och winh rey b'aj ix wa chi', ix yilan winh to kumanem winhaj Amán chi' t'a stz'ey b'aj k'ojanem ix reina chi'. Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Tom tza nib'ej tzixtej ix reina t'a wichanh t'a yol in pat tik? xchi winh. Ayik ix yalan juntzanh lolonel winh rey chi', elanhchamel ix makchaj sat winhaj Amán chi' yuj heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan jun winh chekab' skuchan Harbona icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha t'a spat winhaj Amán tik, ix yak' b'ochajem jun te te' winh jun ch'anhil ix ajk'e ste'el. Hata' ol k'e lokan winhaj Mardoqueo yuj winh yalani, haton winh sk'ulejnak jun tas wach' t'ayach, xchi winh. --Hak'ekk'e lokan winhaj Amán tik t'a jun te te' chi', xchi winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix k'e lokan winhaj Amán chi' t'a te', haton te' ix sb'ok'e winh yuj winhaj Mardoqueo yalani. Icha chi' ix aj sikb'i yowal sk'ol winh rey chi'.
